description: A schematic drawing titled "Diagram 1 Scope of Part P", headed top-left "See paragraphs 2.2 to 2.4" and footed "Reproduced with the permission of the Electrical Contractors' Association". It shows four building outlines and a legend. A green tick marks what Part P covers and a grey cross what it does not. The first outline is divided into "Loft", "Dwelling" and "Business unit", each marked with a green tick and an incoming arrow, with a supply symbol and a meter at the base. The second outline has "Roof space" and "Dwelling" ticks, a supply symbol and a meter at its base, plus a "Business unit" within the same building, with its own supply and meter, marked with a grey cross. The third outline has "Loft" and "Dwelling" ticks, a supply symbol and a meter at its base, and lines running to external boxes "Garden electrics" and "Out-building", both ticked. The right outline, headed "Roof space" with a green tick, stacks "Dwellings" entries and "Shared facilities such as laundries, kitchens and gymnasiums", all ticked with meters, plus a "Business unit" marked with a grey cross, with intake switchgear below it; side labels read "Common access" (ticked) and "Lifts" (crossed out). The legend defines a box with a cross as "Intake switchgear", a half-black square as "Source of electricity supply", and an M-in-circle as "Electricity supply meter".

check.note: Mixes up the symbols: the grey crosses mean "not covered" (business units, lifts) and are not the intake switchgear symbol; the business unit in the second building is inside it, not external.
